sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Rummy are simple yet engaging. Players are dealt a hand of cards and must combine them to create valid sets and runs. A set consists of three or four cards of the same rank, but different suits, while a run consists of three or more cards of the same suit in sequential order. The goal is to get rid of all your cards by forming valid sets and runs, with the player who does so first winning the game.

One of the key features of Rummy is its use of a discard pile. Players can discard any number of cards from their hand, and the next player to the left must pick up the top card from the discard pile and add it to their hand. This adds an extra layer of strategy to the game, as players must carefully consider which cards to discard and which to hold onto.

Rummy also features a variety of special cards, including jokers and wild cards. These cards can be used to substitute for any other card in a set or run, making them a valuable addition to any player's hand.
